pages.text: Sleeves the Kobold never knew where he came from. So one day, he decided to go for a wander.
But the roads were long, and the valleys wide. Sleeves did not know where to begin!
At last, Sleeves came to a friendly little town called Nearburg.
Sleeves went to the local tavern and met some crazy characters! Layla the Elven bard with the lute, Grumby the Orc tavern owner, and Crumbs the little Mousefolk waiter!
Sleeves had so much fun at Nearburg! He met so many new friends and made so many amazing memories! But he never quite fit in with everyone else. He was different.
And so Sleeves decided he would wander a little more, to see if he could find somewhere he could call home.
